action_items.detail: Home 'Discount given' now reads ₹6 L · 5 bookings, not about ₹2.5L · 2. QA tscheck bookings created today with discounts (from the discount and remark tests) are counted in November. The widget figure matched /api/home/bundle pipeline.discount (amount_paise 50000000, 4 bookings, at an earlier moment in this run) and matched the Discount register total.

JRN-97 gaps. At 390 the sweep ran in Night, not Day, because the theme-day toggle could not be reached at that width. /customers/new has no [role=combobox], so the Elite open-and-pick step was not exercised. The construction stage update dialog was not opened; only the /construction page was swept. Day 390 and Elite picking still need a check.

The 3 regression checks failed at first because they pointed at hardcoded QA booking ids and a PAN that were purged. I changed the ids in the scripts to new QA tscheck bookings (RegA, RegF, RegW) and a QA PanDupe customer. All 3 pass after the change. The scripts still have hardcoded ids and will break on the next purge.
localhost:3000 login returns 404 (wrong /api routing). Every browser check therefore ran through the preview URL.
